SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.is_protected, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM t_role r INNER JOIN t_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_role (code, name, description, is_protected, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{isProtected}, NOW(), NOW())
